metadata.title: Write Unit Tests for Service Layer
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Create comprehensive unit tests for service layer with full (100%) code coverage. Use when implementing new services or adding test coverage.

output.description: Unit test files with full code coverage

specificActions: Study Existing Test Patterns: Search for tests of similar services; review naming conventions, mocking patterns, helper classes
Read Target Service Code: Read service implementation; identify public methods; identify dependencies to mock
Identify All Code Paths: Success scenarios; error/exception scenarios; edge cases; boundary conditions
Create Test Class Structure: Create file in Tests/UnitTests/; set up with proper attributes; create constructor with dependency setup
Write Setup Methods: Create mock objects; set up common test data; create test helpers if needed
Write Tests for Each Method: Cover success scenarios first; add error scenarios; add edge cases; follow AAA pattern
Verify Full Coverage: Run tests; check coverage; add missing tests until 100%
tools: read_file - Read service and existing tests
bestPractices: Search for tests of similar service components in Tests/UnitTests/
Review test class naming conventions (ManagerTests, CalculatorTests)
Check Tests/UnitTests/Helpers/Mocks/ for existing mock helper classes
Review mocking library usage (FakeItEasy, Moq, etc.)
Create test helper if mocking same method 3+ times
